articles.title: Sam Bankman-Fried officially asks Trump for a presidential pardon
articles.snippet: The fallen crypto mogul serving a 25-year sentence filed a clemency petition, betting on Donald Trump's history of crypto pardons even though the president had told him not to count on one.

articles.title: A crucial bitcoin market indicator is signaling that the worst of the crypto crash might be over
articles.snippet: The metric shows bitcoin's market price is getting close to its realized fair value after the recent sell-off.

articles.title: Bybit challenges Wall Street with a massive push into tokenized U.S. stock IPOs
articles.snippet: Retail investors can now buy shares at official underwritten prices through the crypto exchange, bypassing Wall Street’s exclusive pre-IPO clubs.

articles.title: Gold slips below 200-day moving average offering glimmer of hope for bitcoin bulls
articles.snippet: Gold falls into bear market territory, while a stronger U.S. dollar and rising rate expectations pressure risk assets.

articles.title: CME is letting traders bet on bitcoin volatility, not price, and two firms have already placed bets
articles.snippet: Monarq and DV Chain kick off trading in CME's bitcoin volatility index futures.
